provenance: Production implementation is independent. Development conformance includes original cases and statically imported upstream fixtures. See conformance/upstreams.json, import-inventory.json, and NOTICE.md for pinned provenance, exclusions, and retained licenses.

statusMeaning.partial: Implemented for the documented subset, with tests; complete parity is not claimed.
statusMeaning.deferred: Not implemented; unsupported syntax is rejected. Options absent from our API are not accepted as configuration.

comment.behavior: Scans complete delimiters and ignores stray closing-brace suffix text after the comment tag name; malformed body delimiters still fail bounded lexical validation.

cycle.behavior: Suppresses JavaScript falsey candidates, including numeric zero; string zero still renders.

#.behavior: Trims leading/trailing argument whitespace before validating subsequent comment lines.

slice.behavior: Preserves JavaScript addition/coercion for start and length, including numeric-string concatenation; allocation accounting uses the resulting bounded slice length.

truncate.behavior: Missing count/suffix arguments use defaults, including missing values preserved through assign; explicit nil remains distinct.

truncatewords.behavior: Missing count/suffix arguments use defaults, including missing values preserved through assign; explicit nil remains distinct.

jekyllInclude.rationale: Deferred: requires static/unquoted filename grammar, equals-separated arguments in an include namespace, and matching project analysis/checker contracts. The imported parse-only case remains explicitly unsupported.

dateFormat.behavior: Default date format when the filter format is nil or omitted.

locale.behavior: Intl month and weekday names; core defaults to en-US.

preserveTimezones.behavior: Preserves offsets from date strings unless the filter supplies a timezone argument; applies to all date aliases.

keepOutputType.rationale: Deferred: render returns Effect<string> and renderStream emits strings. A separate typed-output API needs an owner-approved contract; configuration cannot silently widen existing return types.

memoryLimit.behavior: Cumulative conservative allocation units, capped at 10,000,000; range/filter growth and date widths checked before allocation.

parseLimit.behavior: Source code units, capped by maxSourceLength; inherited by partials.

renderLimit.behavior: Deterministic work budget ceil(renderLimit * 1000), minimum one, capped by maxSteps; no wall-clock deadline.

timezoneOffset.behavior: Numeric minute offset or IANA timezone; explicit filter arguments override configuration.

orderedFilterParameters.behavior: Parse option snapshots for-loop modifier order (offset, limit, reversed) in the AST and propagates to partial rendering, project analysis, and checking. Default remains offset, limit, reversed.

syntax.identifiers: ASCII letter/underscore followed by word characters or hyphens
syntax.lookups: Variable-rooted and bare context bracket access; computed lookup indices; direct literal receiver access; sequence length/size and record size fallback; whitespace before a dot/bracket ends the receiver path, while whitespace after a dot is allowed
syntax.expressions: Literals, ranges, comparisons, contains, not, right-associated and/or, filter pipelines; opt-in parenthesized conditions and pipelines
syntax.partials: Literal or variable template names, interpolated quoted filenames, with/for/as bindings, and comma-separated named arguments.
syntax.loops: limit, numeric offset, reversed, else, and offset:continue; orderedFilterParameters applies modifiers in source order

hostValues.plainRecords: supported with own data properties only

differences.behavior: Defaults true; unknown filter failures occur during rendering rather than parsing.
Dialect-specific: Ruby accepts marked endraw openers and closes at complete tags; LiquidJS uses its pinned delimiter behavior.

Finite limits with typed errors and interruption checkpoints. parseLimit maps to source code units; renderLimit maps to bounded deterministic work rather than elapsed time; memoryLimit uses conservative cumulative allocation units. Existing finite defaults remain caps.
Rejected rather than silently overwriting an earlier expression.
Rejects non-arrays, including short strings and array-like records accepted by the pinned oracle.
Rejected by the finite Liquid value boundary instead of printing Infinity/NaN.
Ruby dialect iterates include for and honors with/as. Default LiquidJS renders once with boolean bare hash arguments.

api.analyze: implemented with bounded fixed-point local flow and explicit partial coverage for unknown summaries
api.analyzeProject: implemented for bounded render dependencies; include summaries are partial
api.check: experimental gradual checker sharing bounded control-flow transfer rules
api.typedTemplates: tagged templates with typed external paths and render context; raw Liquid checked separately
api.schema: decoded structural projection; recursive/opaque shapes are partial
api.customFilters: Effect registry preserves typed errors and service requirements
api.browser: core bundle verified; no Node adapters imported by parser
api.cli: local parse/analyze/render/check; filesystem project CLI deferred

analysis.flow: Reads before writes, branch joins, zero iterations, shadow restoration, capture timing, scoped builtins, and normal/break/continue successors.
analysis.bounds: 16 fixed-point rounds and 100,000 node visits; widened/opaque results are partial.
analysis.remaining: Shared include/project cycles, counter seeds, table-row control quirks, and unknown transformation provenance.

measurement.fixtureEncoding: $liquid tagged integer/float/decimal/symbol/range/hash; separate globals and templates

dialects.snapshot: Document; propagated to loaded partials, analysis/checking, render/stream, CLI and typed templates
